newsitem.title: USA: Zale Corp names exec Beryl Raff new COO.
newsitem.headline: Zale Corp names exec Beryl Raff new COO.

text.p: Zale Corp Monday named Beryl Raff, president of its Zales Jewelers division, as the company's chief operating officer.
A spokeswoman said the position had been vacant since January. Raff will keep on overseeing Zales Jewelers until the company names a new president, a statement said.

The company operates 1,072 retail jewelry stores and lease 185 counters in department stores through its divisions Zales Jewelers, Gordon's Jewelers, Bailey Banks & Biddle and Diamond Park Fine Jewelers.
Zale posted a $1.4 million loss, or $0.04 a share, in the quarter ended April 30, compared with a $2.4 million loss, or $0.07 a share, the year before.
The jeweler's stock traded at 21-7/16 Monday, down 1/16.
